comments.author: Me
comments.body: Between Litzen and Duarte every Adventure skill is covered except for Search, which is the easiest one to rank up at Landing Points and in city outskirts searching for items like Bamboo brooms, Shipwright's saws and Shipwright's hammers. I would say those 2 make the best pair of total Adventure aides to start out with.

comments.author: Mini-me
comments.body: True, and there are more items with a + to Search than all the others pretty much, including the 2 you get from school for free, Instructor Andrea's staff(+1 Search, from the Intermediate Adventure school Graduation chest) and the School Degarine(+1 Search, from the Advanced Adventure school Graduation chest). Also, between the 2 you get all the basic North Sea and Iberian penninsula languages, Dutch, English, Portuguese and Spanish, as well as Celtic, which frees up at least 4 skill slots for adventuring around those areas.
